landing.tagline: Interactive patient cases for clinical education
landing.aboutStudentText: Enter the 4-digit room code given by your teacher. No account or login required – participate and answer anonymously directly from your phone or laptop.
landing.aboutTeacherText: Present a ready .medcase file on the lecture hall screen or create new patient cases in the easy-to-use editor. Student responses aggregate and visualize in real time.
landing.aboutPrivacyText: MedCases does not require cloud accounts or personal data collection. All patient cases are stored locally as .medcase files on your device.
landing.presentCaseDesc: Project to screen. Present one or more cases with the same room code.
landing.createNewDesc: Build a new clinical case and questions in the editor.
landing.editExistingDesc: Open a previously saved case to continue editing.

student.readFromScreen: Follow the presentation on the screen.
